name: everything-claude-code
description: Claude Code toolkit - agents, commands, skills, rules, and hooks for productive AI-assisted development
one_liner: A free, large bundle of pre-built configurations for Claude Code that add specialist helpers (planner, security reviewer, test writer) and shortcuts, built from ten months of one team's real usage.
buyer: A dev team lead who wants a mature, battle-tested Claude Code setup (agents, hooks, rules) without spending weeks building their own configuration from scratch.
business_use_cases: An engineering team installs the security-reviewer and code-reviewer agents to add an automatic first pass before human review, catching issues earlier.
A startup uses the memory-persistence hooks so context survives across sessions, cutting the time engineers spend re-explaining the codebase to the agent.
A solo dev follows the 'Longform Guide' to set up verification loops and evals, effectively getting a QA process they couldn't otherwise afford to build.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a paid, guided 1:1 setup service that installs and tunes this toolkit for a specific company's stack and conventions.
Turn the 'Shorthand' and 'Longform' guides into a paid video course with hands-on labs for teams adopting AI-assisted development at scale.

steal_this: Package the token-optimization and memory-persistence guidance into a one-page 'AI coding cost audit' checklist you sell/give to dev teams as a lead magnet for consulting work.
